issues.on_page: State Receipts: Other 27,515.03 (General 893.02 + Street 65.37 + CDBG Funds 26,556.64 on p2)
issues.issue: 26,556.64 of this line is in the CDBG fund. Community Development Block Grants are federal money passed through the state, so that portion could be federal grants. The line is printed as one row per fund, so no split is printed. The amount is correct and the line is already marked review.
